switching_time: Upon cancellation with Clearview Energy, your electric supply services will be transferred to the default service or another TPS on the next applicable meter read date as established by your Local Distribution Company (LDC).
incentives: A promotional variable rate product with a natural gas rate and base fee guaranteed not to increase for any bill with Clearview Energy processed in the first twelve (12) billing cycles. Any utility bill processed after this date will receive a Clearview Energy variable natural gas rate, and base fee, that may fluctuate month-to-month at Clearview Energy’s discretion and may be higher or lower than the Standard Offer rate, or this introductory rate, for any given billing period.
rescission: You have seven (7) calendar days from the date of the LDC’s confirmation notice to contact your LDC and cancel this Agreement.
start_date: This Agreement goes into effect on the effective date established by the LDC
renewal: This Agreement shall continue on a month to month basis until customer provides at least a 15 day notice of its intent to cancel and until your utility completed the termination in accordance with its rules.
